listen_mode.description: Socket type: unix, inet, or ucspi

unix_socket_path.description: Path to the unix domain socket (used when listen_mode is unix)

inet_ip.description: IP address to bind for inet mode (0 for all interfaces)

inet_port.description: UDP port to bind for inet mode

ucspi_args.description: Arguments for ucspi mode, prepended to syslog messages if env vars exist. Max 8 args.

raw_only.description: If true, use -R flag (raw messages only)

raw_with_conversion.description: If true, use -r flag (raw + converted messages)

respect_umask.description: If true, use -U flag to respect umask for unix sockets
